mainEntity.name: When should my business consider investing in Website Optimization for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your business should consider investing in Website Optimization for AEO when you observe a significant portion of your target audience using voice search or seeking quick answers from search engines. If competitors are already appearing in featured snippets for relevant queries, it indicates a missed opportunity. Businesses with informational content, product guides, or service FAQs are particularly well-suited. Early adoption can give you a competitive edge in capturing this growing segment of search behavior and establishing your authority before it becomes standard practice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider AEO when your audience uses voice search or seeks quick answers, especially if competitors occupy featured snippets. It's beneficial for businesses with informational content.
